scope: Independent read-only inspection of actual installed SDK source/headers inside the current worker container. No pipeline/model/GPU/runtime changes.

findings.behavior: Initializes frameTimeStamp=0/frameTimeValid=false; if frameMeta.ntp_timestamp!=0 uses that value and marks valid; otherwise uses valid Gst frameMeta.buf_pts. localTimestamp remains actual host preparation wall time.
The tracker processing paths call fillMOTFrame for their input frames.
NvMOTTimeStamp uint64; timeMeta.frameTimeStamp documented stream/media time in ns; NvMOTFrame carries the timeMeta object.

candidateImplication: Assign exact native encoded-frame wallcapture ns to NvDsFrameMeta.ntp_timestamp AFTER mux and BEFORE both local NvDCF and native MV3DT, retain original buf_pts. The same nonzero timestamp then becomes actual tracker timeMeta.frameTimeStamp for both stages; export must retain the identical clock. JSON-only timestamp changes would not repair native tracker time.
boundaryConditions: Opt-in native capture mode only; generic RTCP source mode unchanged.
Native SEI timestamp is encoded-frame handoff wall time from the current producer, not independently measured physical exposure.
No simulation-time, fitted offset, host-arrival substitution or GT identity is allowed for this source clock.
Installed source proof establishes the SDK mapping; candidate pad order and exact frame/epoch association require separate source/tests and actual trial.
